momentos.texto: Twice a year, young people from the interior of the whole country take part in the national selection. Those who get in become role models in their own city.
momentos.textoCurto: Selection of young leaders across the whole country.

momentos.texto: Three months of preparation with our team: lesson plans, the reality of public schools and impact assessment.
momentos.textoCurto: Training young people to run the intervention in the public school of their community.

momentos.texto: Each Regional Director brings the Journey to a public school in their region and follows the same class for 6 months.
momentos.textoCurto: The trained Regional Director runs the activities at the school.

momentos.texto: We measure each class before and after the Journey. Each school receives a results report, and the Journey gets an improvement plan for the next cycle.
momentos.textoCurto: We run impact assessments before and after the Journey, and the school receives a final report.

momentos.texto: Students who went through the Journey come back as volunteers and Regional Directors. Each generation trains the next.
momentos.textoCurto: Students who went through the Journey come back as volunteers.
